entry_hook: Culture.SkillStartingValueProg (existing Number(Toon ch, Trait trait, Number boosts) convention; verify actual installed signature before wiring)

helper_contracts.name: CultureLanguageBackgroundFactor
helper_contracts.algorithm: Native ethnic binding => 1.0; specific cultural vernacular => 0.90; qualifying learned/contact definition => its factor. Take maximum. No qualifying language background => 0; a zero delegates to original starting prog.

wrapper_pseudocode: For non-language traits, call the preserved original prog unchanged.
Return backgroundBase + boostDelta to the existing cap/independent-value pipeline.
guardrails: Do not call a wrapper recursively after rewiring the culture.
Do not reapply a boost after the engine has already applied it. Verify the caller and write regression tests.
Do not use current SkillValues to qualify native status; use ethnicity/culture/trait IDs.
The eligibility map is content data; the helper body is an in-game editable prog, not hard-coded immutable C# factors.
Do not replace an existing custom starting prog without preserving/wrapping it and reporting its identity.
Stronger independent values remain under PR #730 ownership/value rules.
New or verified unchanged seed-owned stock caps must accommodate the 200 base; lower custom caps remain authoritative and are reported. Baseline comparison is required before editing an existing cap.
fallback_if_existing_hook_cannot_support: Report the precise blocker. A small guarded prog integration/compilation helper is allowed. Do not implement a general proficiency-level subsystem or resurrect selector stages.
source_basis: User balance decision and existing prog hook; values are not historical measurements.
